description: This file contains implementations of hash-related functions, including binary search for object IDs and hashes, used within a Git-related codebase. It defines methods for searching object identifiers in hash tables, particularly for Git objects, along with some internal utility functions.

methods.name: uint32_t take2(const struct object_id * oid,size_t ofs)
methods.description: Extracts a 16-bit value from an object ID's hash at a given offset.

methods.name: int oid_pos(const struct object_id * oid,const void * table,size_t nr,oid_access_fn fn)
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find the position of a given object ID within a hash table, or the insert position if not found.

methods.name: int bsearch_hash(const unsigned char * hash,const uint32_t * fanout_nbo,const unsigned char * table,size_t stride,uint32_t * result)
methods.description: Performs a binary search on a hash table to find the index of a specific hash value.

ctags.signature: (const unsigned char * hash,const uint32_t * fanout_nbo,const unsigned char * table,size_t stride,uint32_t * result)
